statement: The fresh-seed bootstrap release owner may overlap independent partition cohort cutovers in a bounded admission window while retaining the original SQL_TRANSACTIONS-first priority, deterministic input-order accountability, one original shared 1000/5000ms deadline, exactly one intent per partition, and all per-cohort authentic membership/control pre/post safety. It must await and account for every admitted operation before reporting startup success/failure, so no orphaned release runs survive a refusal.

constraints.statement: This is a proposed change of prior seed-release serialization. The previous seed-release-once-per-partition-cohort and original seed-participant-release-applied-position-barrier Quests remain sealed/open with their original acceptance and no automatic supersession. This WIP is not an accepted new contract until explicit owner judgment and independent review; only an isolated branch may test it.

The existing bootstrap workflow exclusively selects sorted fresh seed partition release intents; the existing registered replica cutover owner owns true member census, current generation, control validations, write pause, origin and admission. Do not implement a second cutover, control classifier or cached OPEN proof. Reuse existing runParticipantCutover per-partition single-flight for naturally overlapping control requests.

Bound launched release tasks by the existing bootstrap config.maxConcurrentServiceActions validated positive integer, not a newly invented timeout, parallelism knob, unbounded Promise.all, poll loop or new scheduler. One shared absolute deadline from nodeService timeSource applies to every task, including deferred slots. No per-cohort budget renewal or test budget increase.

SQL_TRANSACTIONS is first in stable sorted intent order. All submitted releases retain their individual fresh-seed authorization tokens and exact current per-member and control pre/post revalidation. Launches may overlap; resolve results in input order, and after a failed batch, await all already admitted tasks before propagating the first source-ordered failure. No work may be launched after that failure. No partial success is treated as startup-ready.

Original 1s claim/cache trace is 514 complete calls including 21 SQL_TRANSACTIONS nested releases and ten distinct non-control partitions, zero dropped/unfinished, under the single deadline. Compare exact same test, same physical runner WIP source-only negative and candidate positive. Run genuine original 1s and 5s tests, unsafe/corrupt/close/recovery controls and native V10. A green mock or adjusted budget is never enough; require independent review and locked real distributed evidence before main.
